evidence: controller2.log, UTF-16 LE; UnicodeDecodeError at cp1252 byte 0x81, then TypeError in launch polling
remote_stage: Installing pinned packages; run.log did not yet exist, so the poll read install.log.
failure: First host never reported runtime or public IP. Second controller decoded UTF-8 pip progress using Windows cp1252. Its subprocess reader raised UnicodeDecodeError, stdout became None, and polling raised TypeError. Cleanup terminated the pod during package installation.
fix: SSH captures now explicitly decode UTF-8 with replacement; console progress is ASCII escaped; transient polling failures continue within the deadline. A guard prevents a third allocation and cumulative reservations above 2.50 USD.
